title: Column picker lists all 20 available columns with toggles and never offers the internal on-hand cost
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Open the column picker from its toolbar button.
2. Count the columns listed and check each has a toggle.
3. Look for any on-hand cost / inventory-value entry.
custom_expected:
1. The picker lists all 20 available columns, each with a toggle: Type, Part #, Description, Category, Vendor, Units Sold, Units Returned, Sold via WO, Sold via Parts Sale, Unit Cost, Sell Price, Revenue, Margin, Margin %, Demand, Last Sale, On Hand, Turns / Yr, Min, Max.
2. No on-hand cost column is offered - the report computes one internally but it is never selectable and never displayed.
